This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Based Marketing Manager with vertical experience in Financial Services to design and execute highly targeted, data-driven ABM programs for our top strategic accounts—driving pipeline growth, accelerating deals, and increasing customer lifetime value. This role will focus on high-impact campaigns aligned to the Financial Services industry, leveraging industry-specific insights to personalize the buyer journey and deepen executive engagement.

This is a hands-on, strategic role that blends Financial Services vertical expertise, ABM strategy and execution, and cross-functional leadership. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of Financial Services industry pain points, collaborates closely with sales and marketing teams, and thrives in a high-growth, customer-centric environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Financial Services Vertical-Centric ABM Campaigns: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of 1:1 and 1:few ABM campaigns for strategic accounts—tailoring messaging, content, and engagement strategies to Financial Services industry-specific challenges.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with sales, field marketing, campaigns, and product marketing teams to ensure campaigns are aligned with account objectives, vertical GTM strategies, and buyer personas.
  • Data-Driven Insights & Reporting: Use tools like 6sense, Salesforce, and Tableau to monitor engagement, pipeline impact, and ROI. Translate insights into clear campaign optimizations and business recommendations.
  • Executive Engagement: Collaborate with sales leaders to develop executive-level programs that drive alignment and trust with C-level buyers in Financial Services. 
  • ABM Innovation & Enablement: Drive new tactics such as themed call blitzes, strategic gifting, and multi-channel personalization. Enable sellers with tailored playbooks and outbound messaging aligned to industry pain points.
  • Mentorship & Best Practices: Support junior ABM teammates by sharing playbooks, insights, and vertical knowledge to scale successful programs across regions.
  • Budget Management: Manage and optimize ABM budgets, ensuring effective use of resources and clear tracking of program performance.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of B2B field marketing experience, with at least 5+ years focused on ABM and/or strategic account marketing in enterprise tech or SaaS environments.
  • Proven vertical marketing expertise—ideally in Financial Services—with the ability to speak to industry-specific trends, buyer needs, and GTM motions.
  • Advanced proficiency in ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase), Salesforce CRM, and analytics tools such as Tableau.
  • Strong understanding of the customer journey, multi-touch attribution, and end-to-end campaign development.
  • Excellent project management and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working across sales, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience enabling sales teams with tailored messaging and account-based strategies.
  • Team mentorship or leadership experience is a plus.
  • Flexibility to travel up to 50%. This includes time in London with our Sales team and also across our main hubs in the EMEA region for events / meetings with local Field Marketing teams, as required

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline contribution and acceleration from strategic vertical accounts
  • Engagement and conversion within targeted industries
  • Stakeholder alignment and satisfaction (particularly sales and vertical leaders)
  • ROI and efficiency of ABM program spend
  • Internal adoption of ABM best practices and frameworks

Opportunities for Growth

This is a high-visibility role with a strong path toward ABM leadership, vertical strategy, or demand generation ownership. You’ll have a direct impact on shaping how Pure Storage grows in high-potential industries—and how we build lasting relationships with our most important customers.

remote_global.title: Senior Data Architect (North America)
remote_global.description: What you’ll do You’ll join a small, senior Data & Analytics team at a real estate investment firm that has built a sophisticated data platform on Snowflake, pulling together 40+ data sources. The platform has grown fast, and the team now needs an architect who can set the direction: how the data should be layered, modeled, governed, and served so that reporting is reliable and the business can trust it. The immediate priority is financial reporting: mapping account-level activity through account hierarchies into financial statements. You will: Assess and shape the platform architecture. Review the existing Snowflake environment, work out what is actually working and what isn’t, and define the target architecture: layering from raw through staging to marts, naming and grain standards, and how corrections and late-arriving data are handled. Design the financial data model. Model general ledger activity, charts of accounts, and account hierarchies so they roll up cleanly into financial statements and management reporting, and stay consistent as new sources are added. Design for the business, not just the ticket. Work with finance, investment, and operations stakeholders to understand how Transactions, Reporting and source of truth, and Day-to-day decision making depend on the data, and translate that into scalable designs. Own integration design across 40+ sources. Define patterns for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration across real estate systems, finance systems, and external feeds, with attention to lineage, data quality, and testing. Optimize for performance and cost. Guide warehouse sizing, query performance, and cost management in Snowflake, and make trade-offs visible to engineers and non-engineers alike. Set the standard and lead by example. Run design reviews, produce clear design documentation, mentor data engineers, and push back when something isn’t right. Prepare the platform for what’s next. Shape how the team approaches governance, data cataloging, and AI-enabled use cases so outputs are consistent and reusable. What we’re looking for We’re looking for someone highly technical who cares deeply about craft and can explain design choices to people who aren’t engineers. You must bring: 7+ years in data engineering, data architecture, or database engineering, with real ownership of production data platforms Deep, hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred; Databricks or similar considered), including performance tuning and cost management Strong data modeling skills: stating and enforcing grain, dimensional modeling, layered architectures, and handling corrections and late-arriving data Advanced SQL and experience designing efficient schemas for high-volume environments Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and integrations across many sources, with a transformation framework (dbt or similar) and an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, or similar) Finance literacy: experience modeling general ledger data, charts of accounts, and account hierarchies into financial or management reporting Proven ability to diagnose and improve platforms you didn’t build, and to decide what to fix first A quality mindset: testing, data quality, lineage, and clear design documentation (diagrams, decisions, trade-offs) Strong English communication and comfort with remote, asynchronous work across time zones A practical working relationship with AI tools in how you design, build, and document Bonus points for Experience in asset management, investment firms, or commercial real estate Familiarity with systems such as Yardi, MRI, RealPage, Argus, VTS, or CoStar Experience building analytics-ready models for BI tools (Power BI in particular) Exposure to Snowflake AI capabilities (Cortex, agent-building) or data catalog and governance initiatives Leadership of data architecture across multiple projects or business domains A track record of mentoring other engineers Why You'll Love Working Here Real impact. You'll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference. An outstanding team. Talented, kind, hard working people who care about their craft and about each other. No egos. No politics. Growth. You'll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility, at your own pace. A culture of excellence. We care about doing the right thing for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high quality work, delivered sustainably. Variety and stability. We're profitable, independent, and over two decades strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You'll never be bored here. This Role Might Not Be for You We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn't. You should skip this opportunity if: You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate toward a clear hierarchy and well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging. Distributed work isn't your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation, and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won't suit you. Inheriting an existing environment doesn't appeal. This role starts by stabilizing and improving a platform someone else built, with a lot of moving parts. If you only want greenfield projects, you'll find it frustrating. Feedback doesn't excite you. We're obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means feedback that's sometimes nitpicky. If refining work until it's excellent feels over the top, this won't be a fit. Change makes you uncomfortable. Priorities shift and processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy. However, if this sounds like fuel, we'd love to talk. How to Apply and What to Expect in the Interview Process Your work. Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We'll look at depth, the quality of your thinking, and the logic behind your choices. Lateral team fit. You'll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead. Work trial. You'll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do. Engineering deep dive. A collaborative session with our engineers. Project fit. An interview focused on prioritisation, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the messy middle.
